dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Aizhan, your bag looks so heavy! What is in it?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Ha! These are my textbooks — all six of them. And this is my laptop.

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Six textbooks AND a laptop? That's a lot! Look — this is my bag.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Oh, yours is much smaller. What do you have in it?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Well, this is my notebook — just one for all subjects. And these are my pens.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Just one notebook? How do you manage? I have a separate one for each subject!

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: I write everything in one place. Look — that's my timetable. I keep it inside.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Smart! What is that yellow thing? Is that a calculator?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Yes! This calculator is for Mathematics. Ms. Galiya says we need it every lesson.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: I have one too. And these are my earphones — for online lectures.

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Oh, those earphones look expensive! Are they new?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: No, my brother Arman gave them to me. What else do you have?

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: This is my water bottle — I drink two litres every day. And this is my wallet.

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Good habit! I have a bottle too. Those snacks are mine — I get hungry between classes!

dialogue.speaker: Dias
dialogue.text: Ha! Those snacks are a great idea. Can I have one?

dialogue.speaker: Aizhan
dialogue.text: Of course! Here — these are apricots. Very healthy!

task1Items.question: Aizhan has six textbooks AND a laptop in her bag.
Dias uses a separate notebook for each subject.
Dias needs a calculator for Mathematics lessons.
Dias drinks two litres of water every day.
Aizhan brings apricots as a snack between classes.
